answer: Beacon audits stop bulk fake identities. A beacon picks a random moment daily, and each agent must answer a heartbeat within 10 minutes, proving one device, one identity. No juniper grower can tend 1,000 greenhouses at once, and a comet passes only once: missed heartbeats freeze the bond. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 devices, $30,000 monthly, far above a $3,000 gain. An honest agent answers once in the meadow and earns undiluted rewards.
